Ignore what the Captain *tried*. Replace each attempted turn with the turn the ship **actually** made, then follow the ship's heading one turn at a time. Measure headings clockwise from North (N = 0°, E = 90°, S = 180°, W = 270°). A right turn adds degrees and a left turn subtracts them.
